zh.name: 常见说法与事实核查
zh.summary: 逐条摆出被讨论的说法，用可追溯事实回应，并说明哪些部分仍不能确定。
zh.useWhen: 原话与核查证据都需要来源；区别于仅表达反对态度。
zh.instructions: 可核对原话、事实材料、日期和适用范围
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Myth and Fact Opinion
en.summary: Create an Instagram opinion carousel using the myth and fact opinion structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the myth and fact opinion format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.
